svg.title: Canadian passport fees in Canada from 31 March 2026
svg.desc: Fees for applications in Canada on or after 31 March 2026. Adult 10-year passport 163 dollars and 50 cents. Adult 5-year passport 122 dollars and 50 cents. Child passport 58 dollars and 50 cents. Urgent pickup and weekend service are extra. Figures from the Government of Canada fee table.
svg.text: Passport fees in Canada, on or after 31 Mar 2026
Regular fees only. Urgent pickup is an extra $125.75. Weekend or holiday service is an extra $383.50.
Per year of validity the 10-year book is $16.35 and the 5-year book is $24.50.
Two 5-year books cost $245. One 10-year book costs $163.50, if a name change does not force a new one.
A refund of the fee after 30 business days does not refund a non-refundable fare.
Canada.ca fee table, applications on or after 31 Mar 2026. Read again before you pay. Outside Canada the fees are higher.
